_why: Positive control for the beat-sync stub tests (d99d33ec, aaf3caf5). The codex and agy stubs wait for the beat the test asserts on and exit normally at a 20 s deadline, so a heartbeat that never fires must fail the test's own assertion rather than time out. This positive control was run twice by hand; these rows re-run it on every sweep. The two rows are the same mutant on purpose: a row pins one `test`, and each beat-sync test needs its own pin.

mutations.name: codex-heartbeat-never-due
mutations._mechanism: Raise the beat threshold to 999 s. No beat fires within the stub's 20 s deadline, so the worktree comment gets no `running` stamps and the three-interval count fails.

mutations.name: agy-heartbeat-never-due
mutations._mechanism: Same threshold mutant, pinned to the agy transcript beat. No `#hmad-beat` reaches the log, the stub's wait times out and exits normally, and the test's `#hmad-beat in log` assertion fails.
